## Professional Summary

Sarang is a multi-disciplinary creative developer who combines web development, video editing, and visual design to create immersive digital experiences. With a focus on cinematic aesthetics, smooth animations, and storytelling through technology, he delivers premium digital products that feel alive and memorable. He is currently studying Cybersecurity, adding a strong technical security foundation to his creative work.
